name: exists_matroid_of_indep_table
lines: hsub : ∀ (I J : Finset (Fin n)), o J = true → I ⊆ J → o I = true
haug : ∀ (I J : Finset (Fin n)), o I = true → o J = true → I.card < J.card → ∃ e ∈ J, e ∉ I ∧ o (insert e I) = true
⊢ ∃ M, M.E = Set.univ ∧ ∀ (S : Finset (Fin n)), M.Indep ↑S ↔ o S = true
⊢ (IndepMatroid.ofFinset Set.univ (fun S => o S = true) h0 ⋯ ⋯ ⋯).matroid.Indep ↑S ↔ o S = true

steps.tactic:
exact
  ⟨(IndepMatroid.ofFinset (Set.univ : Set (Fin n)) (fun S => o S = true) h0 (fun I J hJ hIJ => hsub I J hJ hIJ)
        (fun I J hI hJ hIJ => haug I J hI hJ hIJ) (fun _ _ => Set.subset_univ _)).matroid,
    rfl, fun S => by simp⟩
